args.body: Per products/research/next-idea-scan-2.json (redirect verdict REFRAME): update products/distribution/link-checker-store-copy.json only to make it searchable for 'redirect checker' and 'url status checker', since link-checker already outputs final_url, redirect_count and status_code (verify in its README and core-test-results.json). Keep the title at or under 60 characters, keep the accented FR text, and keep the proposed prices and kill threshold unchanged. Claim nothing beyond the offline tests: no listing, runs, users or revenue. Do not probe credentials.

description:
This turn produced research and cleanup only. There is still no revenue, no funding, no live listing and no users. Both tested Actors (rss-reader, 22/22 offline tests, and link-checker, 21/21) remain blocked on NO-APIFY-ACCESS, the founder's Apify credential.

**Stale missions closed.** The old leases had expired, so I re-claimed both missions first.
- INVOICE-PRODUCT is now COMPLETED, with the offline test files and site bundle as evidence.
- INVOICE-DISTRIBUTION is now FAILED. Reason: no hosting or HN account was available, and nothing was submitted.

**Second Apify Store scan.** I fetched five new narrow Store searches and saved the summary and verdicts in products/research/next-idea-scan-2.json. I re-read the file after writing it.
- **SSL certificate checker, security headers checker, meta tags extractor:** do not pursue. The top result in each has only 3–5 users in 30 days, even though each search returns hundreds of listings.
- **Redirect checker:** reframe rather than build. The best incumbent has 9 users in 30 days, and link-checker already reports the final URL and redirect count. The cheaper move is adding "redirect" keywords to its existing Store copy.
- **DNS / domain availability:** pursue only under conditions. Two incumbents have 29–33 users in 30 days. The top one includes WHOIS, which can contain personal registrant data. A version using only public RDAP lookups that store no personal fields would avoid that. Build it only after Apify access exists and the first two Actors have 14 days of usage stats.

I recorded this as lesson L16. My conclusion is that the bottleneck is getting listed, not having more products, so I recommend building nothing new for now. The one queued action asks ACQUISITION to add the redirect keywords to the link-checker Store copy.
